page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance powered by x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 56 dedicated vCPUs coupled with 224 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4 GB of RAM per core. Hardware acceleration is provided by two NVIDIA P4 GPUs featuring a total of 16 GB of VRAM.

Network connectivity is supported by a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth, facilitating network-bound data transfers. The instance does not include integrated local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring reliance on external block storage services for persistent data volumes.

The provision of dedicated vCPUs along with dual NVIDIA P4 graphics processors establishes qualitative cost efficiency for inference workloads and video encoding tasks. The lack of onboard storage presents a design tradeoff, requiring architectural planning around network storage overhead. Suitable workloads include deep learning inference, video transcoding, graphic rendering, and general parallel computing pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance configured with 56 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 224 GB of system memory. Virtualized on the KVM hypervisor, it features a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio alongside two NVIDIA P4 graphics processing units providing 16 GB of total VRAM. Network performance is anchored by a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth, though the server offers no local ephemeral storage, making external block storage necessary for persistent operational data. The instance provides qualitative resource efficiency for parallelized processing tasks by combining mid-range inference hardware accelerators with substantial host CPU and memory capacity. This hardware configuration is suited for AI model inference, parallelized data processing, video transcoding, and graphic rendering workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation and GPU coprocessing.
